description: Provision an Azure Cache Redis via Azure Service Operator. Fields mirror the cache.azure.com/v1api20241101 Redis spec.

azureName.description:
AzureName: The name of the resource in Azure. This is often the same as the name of the resource in Kubernetes but it
doesn't have to be.

credentialFrom.description: Name of a Kubernetes Secret holding the Azure credential to use for this resource. Rendered as the serviceoperator.azure.com/credential-from annotation. Leave empty to inherit the credential from the namespace, then from the operator's global credential. The resource's subscription and resource group come from spec.owner, not from this field.
credentialFrom.title: Azure credential Secret

disableAccessKeyAuthentication.description:
DisableAccessKeyAuthentication: Authentication to Redis through access keys is disabled when set as true. Default value
is false.

enableNonSslPort.description: EnableNonSslPort: Specifies whether the non-ssl Redis server port (6379) is enabled.

identity.description: Identity: The identity of the resource.

type.description: Type: Type of managed service identity (where both SystemAssigned and UserAssigned types are allowed).

items.description: Information about the user assigned identity for the resource

reference.description: ResourceReference represents a resource reference, either to a Kubernetes resource or directly to an Azure resource via ARMID

armId.description:
ARMID is a string of the form /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/{resourceProviderNamespace}/{resourceType}/{resourceName}.
The /resourcegroups/{resourceGroupName} bit is optional as some resources are scoped at the subscription level
ARMID is mutually exclusive with Group, Kind, Namespace and Name.

kind.description: Kind is the Kubernetes kind of the resource.

name.description: Name is the Kubernetes name of the resource.

location.description: Location: The geo-location where the resource lives

minimumTlsVersion.description:
MinimumTlsVersion: Optional: requires clients to use a specified TLS version (or higher) to connect (e,g, '1.0', '1.1',
'1.2')

operatorSpec.description:
OperatorSpec: The specification for configuring operator behavior. This field is interpreted by the operator and not
passed directly to Azure

configMapExpressions.description: ConfigMapExpressions: configures where to place operator written dynamic ConfigMaps (created with CEL expressions).

items.description:
DestinationExpression is a CEL expression and a destination to store the result in. The destination may
be a secret or a configmap. The value of the expression is stored at the specified location in
the destination.

annotations.description: Annotations is an optional set of annotations to apply to the destination resource.

key.description:
Key is the key in the ConfigMap or Secret being written to. If the CEL expression in Value returns a string
this is required to identify what key to write to. If the CEL expression in Value returns a map[string]string
Key must not be set, instead the keys written will be determined dynamically based on the keys of the resulting
map[string]string.

labels.description: Labels is an optional set of labels to apply to the destination resource.

name.description:
Name is the name of the Kubernetes configmap or secret to write to.
The configmap or secret will be created in the same namespace as the resource.

value.description:
Value is a CEL expression. The CEL expression may return a string or a map[string]string. For more information
on CEL in ASO see https://azure.github.io/azure-service-operator/guide/expressions/

owner.description:
Owner: The owner of the resource. The owner controls where the resource goes when it is deployed. The owner also
controls the resources lifecycle. When the owner is deleted the resource will also be deleted. Owner is expected to be a
reference to a resources.azure.com/ResourceGroup resource

name.description: This is the name of the Kubernetes resource to reference.

publicNetworkAccess.description:
PublicNetworkAccess: Whether or not public endpoint access is allowed for this cache.  Value is optional but if passed
in, must be 'Enabled' or 'Disabled'. If 'Disabled', private endpoints are the exclusive access method.

redisConfiguration.description:
RedisConfiguration: All Redis Settings. Few possible keys:
rdb-backup-enabled,rdb-storage-connection-string,rdb-backup-frequency,maxmemory-delta,
maxmemory-policy,notify-keyspace-events, aof-backup-enabled, aof-storage-connection-string-0,
aof-storage-connection-string-1 etc.

aad-enabled.description: AadEnabled: Specifies whether AAD based authentication has been enabled or disabled for the cache

aof-backup-enabled.description: AofBackupEnabled: Specifies whether the aof backup is enabled

aof-storage-connection-string-0.description: AofStorageConnectionString0: First storage account connection string

aof-storage-connection-string-1.description: AofStorageConnectionString1: Second storage account connection string

authnotrequired.description:
Authnotrequired: Specifies whether the authentication is disabled. Setting this property is highly discouraged from
security point of view; you should never disable authentication using this property!

maxfragmentationmemory-reserved.description: MaxfragmentationmemoryReserved: Value in megabytes reserved for fragmentation per shard

maxmemory-delta.description: MaxmemoryDelta: Value in megabytes reserved for non-cache usage per shard e.g. failover.

maxmemory-policy.description: MaxmemoryPolicy: The eviction strategy used when your data won't fit within its memory limit.

maxmemory-reserved.description: MaxmemoryReserved: Value in megabytes reserved for non-cache usage per shard e.g. failover.

notify-keyspace-events.description: NotifyKeyspaceEvents: The keyspace events which should be monitored.

preferred-data-persistence-auth-method.description:
PreferredDataPersistenceAuthMethod: Preferred auth method to communicate to storage account used for data persistence,
specify SAS or ManagedIdentity, default value is SAS

rdb-backup-enabled.description: RdbBackupEnabled: Specifies whether the RDB backup is enabled

rdb-backup-frequency.description:
RdbBackupFrequency: Specifies the frequency for creating rdb backup in minutes. Valid values: (15, 30, 60, 360, 720,
1440)

rdb-backup-max-snapshot-count.description: RdbBackupMaxSnapshotCount: Specifies the maximum number of snapshots for rdb backup

rdb-storage-connection-string.description: RdbStorageConnectionString: The storage account connection string for storing rdb file

storage-subscription-id.description: StorageSubscriptionId: SubscriptionId of the storage account for persistence (aof/rdb) using ManagedIdentity.

redisVersion.description:
RedisVersion: Redis version. This should be in the form 'major[.minor]' (only 'major' is required) or the value 'latest'
which refers to the latest stable Redis version that is available. Supported versions: 4.0, 6.0 (latest). Default value
is 'latest'.

replicasPerMaster.description: ReplicasPerMaster: The number of replicas to be created per primary.

replicasPerPrimary.description: ReplicasPerPrimary: The number of replicas to be created per primary.

shardCount.description: ShardCount: The number of shards to be created on a Premium Cluster Cache.

sku.description: Sku: The SKU of the Redis cache to deploy.

capacity.description:
Capacity: The size of the Redis cache to deploy. Valid values: for C (Basic/Standard) family (0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6), for
P (Premium) family (1, 2, 3, 4).

family.description: Family: The SKU family to use. Valid values: (C, P). (C = Basic/Standard, P = Premium).

name.description: Name: The type of Redis cache to deploy. Valid values: (Basic, Standard, Premium)

staticIP.description:
StaticIP: Static IP address. Optionally, may be specified when deploying a Redis cache inside an existing Azure Virtual
Network; auto assigned by default.

subnetReference.description:
SubnetReference: The full resource ID of a subnet in a virtual network to deploy the Redis cache in. Example format:
/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/Microsoft.{Network|ClassicNetwork}/VirtualNetworks/vnet1/subnets/subnet1

armId.description:
ARMID is a string of the form /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/{resourceProviderNamespace}/{resourceType}/{resourceName}.
The /resourcegroups/{resourceGroupName} bit is optional as some resources are scoped at the subscription level
ARMID is mutually exclusive with Group, Kind, Namespace and Name.

group.description: Group is the Kubernetes group of the resource.

kind.description: Kind is the Kubernetes kind of the resource.

name.description: Name is the Kubernetes name of the resource.

tenantSettings.description: TenantSettings: A dictionary of tenant settings

updateChannel.description:
UpdateChannel: Optional: Specifies the update channel for the monthly Redis updates your Redis Cache will receive.
Caches using 'Preview' update channel get latest Redis updates at least 4 weeks ahead of 'Stable' channel caches.
Default value is 'Stable'.

zonalAllocationPolicy.description:
ZonalAllocationPolicy: Optional: Specifies how availability zones are allocated to the Redis cache. 'Automatic' enables
zone redundancy and Azure will automatically select zones based on regional availability and capacity. 'UserDefined'
will select availability zones passed in by you using the 'zones' parameter. 'NoZones' will produce a non-zonal cache.
If 'zonalAllocationPolicy' is not passed, it will be set to 'UserDefined' when zones are passed in, otherwise, it will
be set to 'Automatic' in regions where zones are supported and 'NoZones' in regions where zones are not supported.

zones.description: Zones: A list of availability zones denoting where the resource needs to come from.
